# Hostfluencer

> The marketplace connecting Airbnb and vacation rental hosts with content creators for authentic UGC, brand collabs, and creator stays.

Hostfluencer helps hosts trade off-peak nights for professional photos, videos, and reels with full commercial rights, and lets brands run paid campaigns with vetted creators.

## Pages

- [Home](/): The feed for hospitality collabs — new stays, brand deals, and creator collabs daily.
- [For Hosts](/for-hosts): How vacation rental and Airbnb hosts get UGC by hosting creators.
- [For Creators](/for-creators): How creators apply, get matched, and earn from stays and brand deals.
- [For Brands](/for-brands): How brands launch paid campaigns with vetted hospitality creators.
- [Marketplace](/marketplace): Browse open creator stays and brand deals.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Subscription tiers for creators and per-engagement fees for brands and hosts.
- [Blog](/blog): Tips and guides for hosts and content creators.
- [About Us](/about-us): Team, mission, and how Hostfluencer works.
- [Help Center](/help): FAQs and support.
- [Ambassador Program](/ambassador-program): Earn commissions referring hosts and creators.
- [Creator Resources](/creator-resources): Templates and guides for creators.

## SEO landing pages

- [UGC for Airbnb Hosts](/ugc-for-airbnb-hosts): Professional Airbnb content without the price tag.
- [UGC for Vacation Rentals](/ugc-for-vacation-rentals): Vacation rental content and photography.
- [Influencer Stays for Hosts](/influencer-stays-for-hosts): Turn empty nights into marketing content.
